svg.title: TalonCV: Multimodal Ai / Browser-Local Inference
svg.desc: TalonCV. Private, explainable interview coaching: speech, language and vision models that run entirely in the browser. Five model families in Web Workers: Whisper, MiniLM, YOLO11-face (ONNX), MediaPipe, SmolLM2 Time-aligned audio, visual and transcript evidence feeds deterministic, explainable scores No backend and no inference API: static Next.js export, sessions stored in IndexedDB
